Name: Tent Living
Author: Louplex
Description:
[size=5][center]✦ Tent Living ✦[/center][/size]
[size=3] Changes the farmhouse outer appearance and transforms it into a tent with seasonal wildcamping decorations ʕ ᵔᴥᵔ ʔ[/size]

[size=3]Tent comes in green and orange. Green is nice in foresty surroundings, orange looks perfect on beach farms.
Toned version fits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367] Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] best but will work with other Recolorations.[/size]

[size=3]The collision is not perfect, close to the entrance it's possible to walk a bit over the fence. Also the chimney-steam will still show sometimes. It's the best i could do since via Alternative Textures there's no reprogramming of the Farmhouse collision and steam. I wanted it this way to just create a simple Overlay via Alternative Textures.[/size]
[size=2]If i feel like, or in case many will ask for it, i could do a Content Patcher Version in the future. I may look into the collision and steam stuff then.
[/size]
I recomend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22990]Tiny Farmhouse[/url] as interior layout that fits a smol Tent better, but thats totally optional. Any interior layout will work.

[size=3]﻿Download via Mod Manager or manually.
If manually, drop in 'Mods' Folder using SMAPI.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] needed.
Buy The Paint Bucket at Robin's and alpply it to the Farmhouse to change Appearance.

[/size][list]
[/list][size=3]Check out my Mod [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19423/?tab=description&jump_to_comment=131186618]Prettier Interior[/url][size=3] ✨[/size]
